title: Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 experimental flying-wing aircraft in flight (Fig. 4)
description: Taped-in print of the British Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 tailless swept-wing jet in flight over fields, with fins at each wingtip and a label reading "ARMSTRONG WHITWORTH A.W. 52 Experimental Flying-wing Aircraft". Typed text above describes the AW 52 G glider and AW 52 twin-jet and lists specifications (span 90 ft, length 37 ft, 2 Nene II turbo jet units). Captioned "Fig. 4".
